summary: Investigated evidence_blobs 0600 security guarantee. Both src/mac/evidence_blobs.py and tests/test_evidence_blobs.py were verified correct in the baseline. Module docstring documents the 0600 guarantee; store_blob() calls path.chmod(0o600) after atomic rename. All 9 original evidence_blobs tests passed. Full contract suite: 5663 passed, 21 skipped, 0 failures. Added 7 new tests covering previously-uncovered branches (inline_max_bytes defaults, invalid digest, bad URI schemes, expected_sha256 mismatch, temp-file cleanup on write error), improving evidence_blobs.py coverage from 79.38% to 95.88%.

evidence_blobs_py.chmod_location: After atomic rename (os.replace) in store_blob(), inside a try/except OSError to handle read-only filesystems gracefully
evidence_blobs_py.notes: The implementation is correct. chmod is applied to the final path after the atomic rename, not to the temp file. The OSError guard prevents failures on filesystems that do not support chmod.
